newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Cocoa eyes 1,020 stg support, upside slim.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Cocoa eyes 1,020 stg support, upside slim.

text.p: DEC Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
LIFFE cocoa futures were likely to drift lower with the second-month December contract moving towards nearby support at 1,020 stg, technical analysts said on Monday.
The market was called to open five stg down from Friday's close.
Elli Gifford, an independent technical analyst, said the initial 1,030 support could well give way.
The market had bounced off the 1,030 stg level on three occasions in the past week.
The next significant support is pegged at 1,020.
On the upside, resistance is seen at 1,060, followed by the August 12 peak of 1,070.
But Gifford doubted that the initial hurdle would be challenged.

After the New York market had closed on Friday, the U.S. CFTC Commitment of Traders report showed an expected decline in speculative net long positions. But traders said it was unlikely to have any impact on the market.
They also said while the technical picture looked weak, concerns that an El Nino weather pattern could adversely affect cocoa crops in Indonesia and Malaysia could underpin the market.
